ModMetaData.name: Rimlike: Roguelike Runs
ModMetaData.author: Matt
ModMetaData.description:
Turns RimWorld into a squad roguelike. A run is three acts of nodes laid out across the planet: pick a path, land your squad, and build a real colony for each node's objective before its weather turns deadly. Raid camps, escort refugees, assault enemy bases, rest, trade and loot along the way.
- Card picks after every node: relics, gear, implants, blueprints, research and recruits. - Base-building expeditions sized to weeks of play, with weather that worsens faster while you fall behind. - Leave with only what your squad can carry, then teleport straight into the next node. - Meta progression: points unlock new starters, pool additions and bonuses; Ascension levels stack handicaps. - Starters for Royalty, Ideology, Biotech (one per xenotype) and Anomaly, all optional.
Start with New colony and pick a starter. Requires Harmony. Disable the mod to play standard RimWorld.
